name: Narumi Marine
source: A first-year student and Yuuma's non-blood-related sister. She loves her brother very much. She came to Amanoshima island in order to research "condensed energy water" for some totally "pure and innocent" purposes. Marine is also the one who kidnapped Yuuma and brought him to Amanoshima Island.
